title: Benchmarking decision models against generative large language models on medical multiple-choice questions
abstract: arXiv:2610.38448v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical workflows often require selecting among predefined options. We compared 13 decision models with 15 generative large language model configurations, including different reasoning settings, using 1,273 four-option MedQA questions under text-only conditions. Accuracy ranged from 67.71% to 89.08% for decision models and from 78.32% to 96.86% for generative configurations. Among the tested configurations, Mercury Decide had the lowest mean final-attempt cost (USD 0.0069 per 1,000 questions), while Clef Omni had the shortest median request duration (0.291 seconds). Decision-model probabilities distinguished correct from incorrect answers, but error rates among answers assigned probabilities of at least 0.90 ranged from 1.71% to 12.77%. Answer agreement across three runs ranged from 92.30% to 100%, while probability repeatability varied. translated_title: 在医学多选题上将决策模型与生成式大语言模型进行基准对比
translated_abstract: 医疗工作流程通常需要在预定义选项中进行选择。我们在纯文本条件下，使用1,273道四选项的MedQA题目，将13种决策模型与15种生成式大语言模型配置（包括不同的推理设置）进行了比较。决策模型的准确率介于67.71%至89.08%之间，而生成式配置的准确率介于78.32%至96.86%之间。在所有测试配置中，Mercury Decide的平均最终尝试成本最低（每1,000道题0.0069美元），Clef Omni的中位数请求时长最短（0.291秒）。决策模型输出的概率能够区分正确与错误答案，但被赋予至少0.90概率的答案中错误率仍介于1.71%至12.77%之间。三次运行中的答案一致性介于92.30%至100%，而概率的可重复性则参差不齐。决策模型在具有资源优势的同时峰值准确率较低；在医疗场景中选择模型时……
tldr: 该研究在1,273道MedQA医学多选题上系统对比了13种决策模型与15种生成式大语言模型配置，发现生成式模型准确率更高（最高达96.86%），而决策模型在成本与速度上更具优势，为医疗场景下的模型选择提供了实证依据。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarked 13 decision models against 15 generative LLM configurations on 1,273 MedQA multiple-choice questions, showing that generative models achieve higher accuracy (up to 96.86%) while decision models offer cost and speed advantages, providing empirical guidance for model selection in medical workflows.
